difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward along the localization morphism attached to a sheaf: on an object it consists of the maps from the restriction of the sheaf to itself which are right inverses to the restriction of the given map (statement lines 7593-7604). The proof is a complete computation: the value is written as a set of morphisms in the slice and identified as a fibre of a map induced by composition (proof lines 7606-7623); the internal hom adjunction rewrites that fibre as a sheaf of maps, and the fibre condition becomes the right inverse condition after restricting to the object (proof lines 7624-7652); the result is the displayed description (proof lines 7653-7662). The non-formal content is the identification of the fibre condition with the right inverse condition. The claim is H2: a computation carried out in two steps with each input named.
